title: Sr. Director, Process Engineering
text:
R3 Lithium operates North America's first commercial scale lithium carbonate recovery facility, located in Covington, Georgia. Using a lithium-first extraction process, the company recovers, refines, and returns lithium carbonate from recycled black mass into the battery supply chain for energy storage systems, defense applications, and electric vehicles. Founded in 2026 and privately held, R3 Lithium is headquartered at 9176 Industrial Drive NE, Covington, Georgia. For more information, visit www.r3lithium.com

R3 Lithium is seeking a highly experienced **Lead Discipline Process Engineer** to provide technical leadership for process design, process optimization, and operational excellence across lithium processing and manufacturing operations. This position serves as the subject matter expert for process engineering and is responsible for leading process design activities, supporting project execution, troubleshooting operational challenges, and driving continuous improvement initiatives that enhance safety, reliability, quality, and production performance.

The successful candidate will play a key leadership role in the development, commissioning, and optimization of lithium processing facilities while collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering, operations, maintenance, and project teams.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Process Engineering, or related engineering discipline required.
* Master's degree preferred.

**Experience**

* Minimum **15+ years of progressively responsible process engineering experience** in lithium, chemical processing, mining, hydrometallurgical, battery materials, refining, or industrial manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading process engineering activities for large capital projects and operating facilities.
* Experience supporting facility commissioning, start-up, troubleshooting, and process optimization.
* Strong understanding of process simulation, process control, mass and energy balances, and industrial process design.
* Proven leadership experience mentoring engineers and leading multidisciplinary technical teams.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Process Engineering Leadership**

* Serve as the technical lead and discipline authority for all process engineering activities.
* Develop and oversee process engineering standards, specifications, and best practices.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to process engineers and project teams.
* Review and approve engineering deliverables to ensure technical accuracy and compliance with design requirements.

**Process Design & Project Execution**

* Lead process design efforts including:
* + Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs)
 + Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs)
 + Heat and Material Balances
 + Equipment Sizing and Specification
 + Process Control Philosophies
 + Process Hazard Analyses (PHA/HAZOP)
* Support feasibility studies, front-end engineering design (FEED), detailed engineering, commissioning, and startup activities.
* Participate in technology evaluations, vendor selection, and equipment procurement activities.
* Support capital project planning, budgeting, scheduling, and execution.

**Process Optimization & Operational Excellence**

* Identify and implement opportunities to improve production efficiency, recovery rates, throughput, product quality, and operating costs.
* Lead root cause investigations and corrective action programs for process-related issues.
* Utilize process data analytics to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives.
* Develop performance metrics and monitor process key performance indicators (KPIs).

**Safety, Environmental & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure process designs and operating practices comply with applicable safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead participation in HAZOP studies, Management of Change (MOC), and risk assessments.
* Promote a strong safety culture and operational discipline throughout the organization.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with lithium extraction, lithium conversion, lithium salts production, hydrometallurgical processing, or battery materials manufacturing.
* Experience with Aspen HYSYS, Aspen Plus, MATLAB, or other process modeling software.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred.
* Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification preferred.
* Experience supporting greenfield facility development and startup activities.

**Core Competencies**

* Process Design & Engineering
* Hydrometallurgical Processing
* Chemical Plant Operations
* Process Simulation & Modeling
* Capital Project Execution
* Process Safety Management (PSM)
* Root Cause Analysis
* Commissioning & Startup
* Continuous Improvement
* Team Leadership & Mentorship
* Technical Risk Assessment
* Cross-Functional Collaboration

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Plant Throughput & Capacity Utilization
* Process Recovery Rates
* Yield Improvement
* Operating Cost Reduction
* Process Reliability & Uptime
* Safety Performance Metrics
* Environmental Compliance
* Successful Capital Project Delivery
* Process Improvement Savings
* Engineering Quality and Execution
